value.rationale: The exact 11-word optimum is the first two-deletion list-size-two finite length where the maximum code cannot be formed as a union of two uniquely decodable codes, a motivated structural synchronization-coding threshold. It extends beyond merely recomputing the previously tabulated unique value five or repeating the one-deletion phenomenon; no all-length conclusion is asserted.
